name: Footwear Stock by Size Run
query:
SELECT
  fsm.style_code as "Style Code:Data:120",
  fsm.style_name as "Style Name:Data:150",
  fsr.size_run_name as "Size Run:Link/Footwear Size Run:150",
  fsm.item as "Item:Link/Item:150"
FROM `tabFootwear Style Master` fsm
LEFT JOIN `tabFootwear Size Run` fsr ON fsr.name = fsm.size_run
WHERE fsm.status = "Active"
AND (%(style)s IS NULL OR %(style)s = '' OR fsm.name = %(style)s)
ORDER BY fsm.style_code
